title: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: 近年来,中国东北地区正在大力开发冰雪资源。例如,哈尔滨利用丰富的冰雪资源打造了极具地方特色的"冰雪大世界",让游客在欣赏冰雪之美的同时也能体验当地独特的民俗文化。如今,曾令人畏惧的冰天雪地正吸引着四面八方的游客,成为深受欢迎的旅游胜地。冰雪旅游业正为当地的经济发展做出越来越大的贡献。
reference: In recent years, Northeast China has been vigorously developing its ice and snow resources. For example, Harbin has built the Ice and Snow World with strong local characteristics by making full use of its rich ice and snow resources, allowing tourists to experience the unique local folk culture while enjoying the beauty of ice and snow. Today, the once-feared land of ice and snow is attracting tourists from all directions and has become a popular tourist destination. Ice and snow tourism is making an increasingly great contribution to the local economic development.
